{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABYuA58Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhCTCr8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 39, "title": "Guide first-time visitors into activating AI residents without hunting through Settings", "body": "## Problem

Ten fictional AI residents and 30 seeded conversations now exist immediately on a first visit (#35, #37), but **future AI activity does not start until the visitor discovers a nested Settings panel and presses `モデルを読み込む（初回ダウンロード）`**. New worlds have automatic activity ON but `ai-activity.consent=false`, so the residents appear active from their history but are effectively silent without an easily discoverable setup path. Typical users will not know what is missing.

The desired first-use experience is **a living PC-VAN whose AI setup is discoverable from the main screen**, without cluttering the 1996-style terminal or initiating a surprise multi-hundred-MB/GB download.

## Expected outcome

On the first eligible visit, show a **small, readable, accessible, non-blocking onboarding invitation outside the terminal transcript** (e.g. a compact notice near the terminal controls/header; not a wall of explanatory text or a large forced modal):

> 10人の常連たちの会話を続けられます。AIの準備をしますか？
>
> [AI住人を有効にする] [あとで]

This is illustrative Japanese UI copy, not a historical PC-VAN menu or required literal wording.

- The primary action must lead **directly to the model preparation/consent flow**; users must *not* have to search through Settings or expand nested sections just to find the button.
- Before any substantial model download, show a **clear one-time confirmation** that the selected local WebLLM model downloads hundreds of MB to GB from distribution hosts, uses browser storage and WebGPU/GPU memory, and that inference remains entirely local. A lightweight default model is fine; reuse the existing model selector and initialization path rather than creating a second AI engine.
- Only **an explicit affirmative user action** starts download/loads the model and persists consent. A passive page visit, the notice being displayed, a default-ON activity flag, or pressing “あとで” must never authorize downloads.
- Loading progress, a cancel/stop action, errors, unsupported-GPU fallback, and eventual ready/active state must be visible or readily opened without losing the user's place.
- The existing 30 historical-style fictional seed posts stay visible immediately regardless of setup, and normal keyboard navigation, posting, Settings and backups remain fully usable.

## Context

Current `main` (reinspect before implementation):
- `src/settings.ts`: all modern controls live in the `設定 / Options` modal, with AI under a collapsed `.ai-controls` `details` panel. `settings.open('ai')` is available, but merely routing to a hidden panel is not enough if it still makes the user discover and identify the download action.
- `src/ai/controls.ts`: `.ai-load` button currently calls `actions.activity.authorizeModel(model.value)` then `loadEngine(...)`. `showActivity` displays `AI 設定が必要` when `state.maxPosts > 0 && !state.consent`; `openActivity/tick` only perform autonomous generation once consent and a due batch exist. Model selection, `AI を停止・解放`, progress and failures already exist.
- `src/main.ts`: session startup calls `repository.openActivity()` and `ai.openActivity(...)`. There is no first-use onboarding surface. Settings are collected after controls are mounted, so the new notice must synchronize with asynchronously loaded/replaced storage state.
- `src/ai/personas.ts` has ten independent resident profiles and a pinned small Qwen model choice; `src/storage/repository.ts` persists the `ai-activity` consent setting; `src/storage/schema.ts` validates settings and backup imports. `docs/local-ai.md` describes one-time consent and later automatic model loading.
- #37 adds 30 static local-seed posts before any consent, distinct from dynamic generated AI content.
- Follow [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/AGENTS.md), [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md), [Issue template](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md), and [review guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md). Write Issue/PR/docs in English and in-app text in Japanese.

### Interaction guidelines

- **Discoverable, not disruptive:** onboarding belongs in a modern UI affordance (small notice, optional popover or modest status strip), never inserted into the PC-VAN command output, MAIN menu, or SIG messages. Keep the terminal visually dominant and usable.
- **Ask only when needed:** initial consent missing AND global resident activity enabled AND WebGPU-compatible browser is eligible. If WebGPU is unsupported, show a compact explanatory status rather than a dead-end “Enable” action. If global activity is intentionally disabled or prior consent is present, do not repeatedly ask. Do not reopen the invitation on every navigation/reconnect.
- **Respect decisions:** “あとで” dismisses the invitation without changing consent, prompts or activity. Avoid nagging on each reload: persist a reasonable deferral state (and provide a deliberate re-entry via a subtle “AIの準備” status/action or Settings). Provide a clear way to leave activity paused/disabled using existing controls. Ensure restored backups/replaced worlds and activity reconfiguration re-evaluate the correct state instead of trusting stale UI flags.
- **Progress & failure:** once a user confirms setup, show real model-loading progress and allow cancellation using the existing adapter/cancel path; report download/GPU/storage errors concisely with retry affordance. Do not claim “ready” merely because download consent was recorded; readiness requires successful model load. A later visit may load the already-authorized model automatically when work is scheduled, as before.
- Avoid automatically downloading extra models, transmitting forum content to third-party inference services, creating remote accounts, or requiring any backend. Do not change the 10-resident scheduler, first-visit seed data or historical reconstruction for this UX issue.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] A fresh, eligible first-time visitor gets a visible but unobtrusive Japanese AI-setup invitation near the terminal, without navigating to Settings. The invitation does not interrupt the connection animation, block keyboard commands, obscure terminal text, or change historical menu output.
- [ ] The **primary CTA is actionable end-to-end** from the initial view: it leads to a concise explicit download/storage/WebGPU consent confirmation and starts the existing WebLLM model-load code after affirmation, with no need to locate and press a hidden Settings-only button. Reuse existing model/provider controls and default model choices. Declining, dismissing, pressing Escape, or doing nothing performs zero model download.
- [ ] On affirmative consent, status/progress/cancel/error and successful ready state are understandable. If feasible, show the eventual “10人の住人が活動中/準備済み” distinction accurately: initial consent/loading/ready, and actual scheduled activity are **not** the same state. A successful model load does not guarantee immediate posts; show the existing simulated-activity schedule status without inventing real-time network presence.
- [ ] Existing already-consented profiles are not asked again, and an explicitly paused global activity setting is respected. “あとで” persists a non-nagging deferral, with clear opt-in reentry from the visible UI or Settings. Unsupported browsers get a useful compact explanation (WebGPU/HTTPS needs) instead of a broken download CTA.
- [ ] Model downloads remain exclusively **opt-in**, notwithstanding auto-activity ON by default. Preserve the existing `authorizeModel` transaction semantics, safe failed/cancelled loads, cache checks, bounded worker usage and later automatic model reuse. Do not add a second background loading/inference path or consent mechanism inconsistent with stored state.
- [ ] After reload, reconnect, multiple tabs, Settings edits, deliberate disable/re-enable, data restore or import, the invitation/status reflects current **persisted** consent and activity state and cannot activate the wrong world or wrong model due to stale callbacks. Keep the 30 local seed posts readable throughout.
- [ ] Preserve accessibility and Japanese IME behavior: keyboard reachability, useful focus management and return-to-terminal focus, screen-reader status messaging, Escape handling, reduced-motion preferences and narrow/mobile responsive display.
- [ ] Add browser/UI tests with a mock AI adapter for fresh profiles, dismissal/deferral/re-entry, affirmative consent, real start-vs-no-start assertion, progress/cancel/failure/ready messaging, unsupported WebGPU, already-consented and explicitly disabled worlds, import/restore state changes, Settings integration and no regression to terminal flow. Existing AI/forum/activity tests continue to pass without actual model download.
- [ ] Update README and local-AI/setup documentation with the new onboarding path, exact consent boundary and re-entry route; run `npm test` / build and record observed results in the PR.

## Optional validation

Manually inspect the onboarding notice on desktop/mobile browsers and confirm that a first-time user can recognize how to start the AI community without hunting in Settings. Try one real WebGPU model download/stop/resume on supported hardware for usability; these device-dependent checks are useful but not pre-merge gates.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. Static built app and mocked-browser flows can validate the onboarding before merge; GitHub Pages publication may be observed separately.
